business.name: realistic_portrait_artist
business.description:
Turning Memories Into Timeless Art.
Welcome to Realistic Portrait Artist, a Hyderabad-based custom portrait studio specializing in beautifully detailed, handmade portraits created from your favorite photographs.
Every portrait is carefully drawn by hand using premium graphite, charcoal, and colored pencils, with special attention to facial expressions, fine details, textures, and the emotions that make each person unique.
Whether you're looking for a meaningful birthday gift, anniversary present, wedding gift, family portrait, memorial artwork, couple portrait, or a special keepsake, we transform your precious memories into artwork you can cherish for years.

servicesNotes: Final pricing may vary depending on background complexity, number of subjects & level of detailing.
50% advance required to confirm your commission slot.
Please book at least 15–20 days in advance.
